| Day | Date | Note |

|---|---|---|

| 78th Army Day | 15 Jan | Jaipur — 4th time outside Delhi cantonment |

| NDA's 77th Raising Day | 16 Jan | Consecutive to Army Day — high mix-up risk |

| 16th National Voters Day | 25 Jan | Theme: "My India, My Vote" |

| National Women's Day | 13 Feb | Sarojini Naidu's birth anniversary |

| Arunachal Pradesh Statehood Day (40th) | 20 Feb | 24th state, 1987 |

| National Science Day | 28 Feb | Raman Effect (Nobel 1930); theme: Women in Science |

| ESIC Foundation Day (75th year) | 24 Feb | Act 1948, scheme launched 24 Feb 1952 |

| Civil Accounts Day (50th edn) | 1 Mar | — |

| World Wildlife Day | 3 Mar | Medicinal & Aromatic Plants |

| 8th Janaushadhi Diwas (+Saptah 1-7 Mar) | 7 Mar | — |

| International Women's Day | 8 Mar | Rights. Justice. Action. |

| World Kidney Day | 12 Mar | Kidney Health for All |

| International Day of Forests | 21 Mar | Forests and economies |

| World Water Day | 22 Mar | Water and Gender |

| Shaheed Diwas | 23 Mar | Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, Sukhdev (hanged 1931) |

| World Tuberculosis Day | 24 Mar | Yes! We can end TB! |

| Earth Hour (20th edn) | 28 Mar | 8:30-9:30 PM, WWF, since 2007 |
🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Army Day/NDA Day pair (Jan); National Science Day/ESIC 75th (Feb); 8th Janaushadhi Diwas + Civil Accounts Day's 50th edition (Mar) — milestone editions are frequently tested.
